why: The arrow turns 45 degrees clockwise each step: right, down-right, down, down-left. The next turn makes it point left, which is option 2. Option 4 (down) goes backwards and option 3 (right) jumps back to the start.
trick: For a turning arrow, find the size of the turn (45 or 90 degrees) and turn once more.
